_comment: Apollo CSM/LM/S-IVB mass, propulsion and inertia data. Values are rounded public figures for the Apollo 11 vehicle [published] or engineering estimates [estimated]; see README.md (Fidelity). Masses in kg, forces in N, lengths in m, inertia in kg*m^2.

sps._source: AJ10-137: 20,500 lbf vacuum thrust, Isp 314 s [published]

sm_rcs._source: R-4D, 100 lbf, Isp ~290 s; four quads [published]; usable load per quad [estimated]

cm_rcs._source: SE-8, 93 lbf, two independent rings [published]; load [estimated]

sivb._source: J-2 vacuum thrust ~1,000 kN, Isp ~421 s [published]; propellant remaining at TLI [estimated]

cm_aero._source: Hypersonic trim CD ~1.29, L/D ~0.30 on 3.91 m diameter [published, rounded]

els._source: Two 16.5 ft drogues at 24,000 ft, three 83.5 ft mains at 10,000 ft [published]; CdS [estimated]
